+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Freeze Athena reference and compare full Brio-Wu numerical profiles."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+import matplotlib
+matplotlib.use("Agg")
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+SOLVER = HERE.parents[1]
+ROOT = SOLVER.parent
+tab = HERE/"output/Brio-Wu.block0.out1.00001.tab"

+             [("x",1),("rho",2),("p",3),("vx",4),("vy",5),("Bx",7),("By",8)]}
+names = ["x","rho","vx","vy","p","Bx","By"]

+           delimiter=",", header=",".join(names), comments="", fmt="%.16e")
+
+
+def average_reference(values, n):
+    cumulative = np.r_[0, np.cumsum(values)/len(values)]
+    return np.diff(np.interp(np.linspace(0,1,n+1), np.linspace(0,1,len(values)+1), cumulative))*n
+
+

+metrics = {}

+    for method in ["baseline_1600","split_GLM_1600","baseline_6400"]:

+            a = curves[method]
+            values[method] = {field:float(np.interp(state["x"],a["x"],a[field])) for field in ["rho","vx","vy","p","Bx","By"]}

+out = dict(reference="Independent Athena++ 8192-cell HLLD, characteristic PPM, SSPRK3, t=0.1",
+           paper="https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-4365/ab929b",
+           published_plateau_source="https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.09568 (Table 1)",
+           caveat="Brio-Wu admits nonunique wave patterns. Published table branch omits the intermediate shock; full-profile errors here use the independent Athena numerical branch, not a claimed unique exact solution.",
